title: Program at Lodi library to explore state's mysterious creatures
excerpt: From Bigfoot to werewolves, strange creatures are part of Wisconsin's folklore.
content:
From Bigfoot to werewolves, strange creatures are part of Wisconsin's folklore.

Paranormal author Chad Lewis will tell more about these oddities during a  program titled Mysterious Creatures of Wisconsin at the Lodi Public Library on Oct. 12.

This program takes the audience on a visual journey to remote areas of the state where monsters are said to lurk. It will explore strange tales of Bigfoot lurking in the woods, aliens abducting humans, deadly sea serpents, and werewolves prowling the countryside. From all corners of Wisconsin to your own backyard, no place is safe from these legends.

The free presentation begins at 5:30 p.m. on Oct. 12.

Lewis has written a number of books about the paranormal. For over three decades, he has traveled the back roads of the world in search of the strange and unusual.

From tracking vampires in Transylvania and searching for the elusive monster of Loch Ness to trailing the dangerous Tata Duende through remote villages of Belize and searching for ghosts in Ireland's haunted castles, Lewis has scoured the earth in search of the paranormal.

Lewis has been featured on the Discovery Channel's A Haunting, William Shatner's Weird or What, ABC's Scariest Places on Earth, Monsters and Mysteries in America and Beyond Belief along with being a frequent contributor on Ripley's Believe it or Not Radio. With a master's degree in psychology, he has authored over 35 books on the supernatural and extensively lectures on his findings.
